transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess what finally made me come in is that... my appetite has just been all over the place for months. There are stretches where I just skip dinner entirely, and... I've lost some weight without really trying to. And other nights, I just pick at crackers or a bowl of cereal because... well, cooking for myself just feels sort of pointless lately.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Um... I don't know. I haven't really thought about it like that. I'm not sure I'd say I feel sad, exactly... I just haven't been paying much attention to it, I guess.
Have you been enjoying things you usually like to do?

Um... I mean, I still do things. I go through the motions, I guess. Like... watering the garden, or showing up to my book club. But... I don't know, it just feels kind of flat lately. Sometimes I end up leaving early, or... I just don't start at all. So... yeah.
Do you feel like you're getting any pleasure out of the things you're still doing?
Um... no, not really. Like I just said, I'm mostly just... going through the motions. I don't really get anything out of it right now. It just stays flat.
Do you often feel guilty about things?

Um... I don't know if guilt is the right word. I just... I think about my marriage a lot. I keep replaying it in my head, over and over. I just keep telling myself I must have... failed at something basic, you know? Like I did something wrong. Even though... I mean, part of me knows relationships are more complicated than that. But... yeah. I just think about it a lot.
How much weight have you lost over these months?

Um... I don't know the exact number. I haven't really been weighing myself. But... I have lost some without trying to. 

My appetite has just been all over the place for months. That's actually... I guess that's what finally made me come in. There are stretches where I just skip dinner entirely. Or... other nights I'll just pick at some crackers or a bowl of cereal. Cooking just for myself... it just feels kind of pointless right now. So... yeah, I've lost some weight.
Would you say your weight loss is more than 5% of your original body weight?

I... I really couldn't say if it's five percent. Like I just said, I haven't stepped on a scale. I just know I'm losing it without trying because... well, because of what I just mentioned. My appetite is just off and I'm skipping meals.
Has your clothing become noticeably looser over the past few months?

I suppose so. A few pairs of pants are a bit baggy now. But... like I was saying, that's really what finally made me come in to see you. My appetite being all over the place for months, and losing this weight without trying. Just... skipping dinner or picking at crackers because cooking for myself feels pointless. So... yes, I guess my clothes are a little looser.
Do you think you've lost weight to the point where others have noticed?

I don't really know if anyone else has noticed. I don't really ask. But... like I've been saying, the whole reason I'm here is because my appetite has been so unpredictable for months. Skipping dinner, losing weight without meaning to... or just eating cereal because cooking for one feels so pointless. That's... that's what brought me in.
Has your weight loss been significant enough that you've had to buy smaller clothes?

No... I haven't gone shopping for new clothes.

I don't really know. I haven't thought about it.

And by the time I get home, I'm too exhausted to cook, or stretch, or even answer personal messages. I don't know if that's because of the weight loss, but... yeah, my energy is low.
Do you think you appear underweight or overly thin to yourself when you look in the mirror?
Not really. I... I don't spend a lot of time looking in the mirror these days. Just enough to get ready for work, I guess. So, no... I haven't really noticed looking overly thin.

I'm not sure. I mean... like I mentioned before, the weight is just coming off because my appetite has been so unpredictable for months. I just... haven't really thought of it like that.
Do you think your weight loss is affecting your daily activities?

I suppose so. I mean... I'm still getting to work every day. But... my documentation keeps backing up. I've had to stay late a few times just to fix things that I used to handle easily.
